sections.content: I am writing in support of [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] as [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] looks for [HOUSING_SITUATION]. I have been [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME]’s counselor since [HOUSING_START_DATE], and in that time I have seen [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] stay motivated and make steady progress.
In my experience, [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] shows these strengths, which I believe will carry over to shared living:
I expect that [CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] will respect the agreements and boundaries of a shared home.

[CLIENT_FIRST_NAME] has signed a release of information allowing me to share this letter. If you have questions, I’m glad to answer what I can within that release. I can be reached at [CLINICIAN_CONTACT].
